---
title: Deploy the backend
description: Deploy the project backend from Console → Deploy.
sidebar:
  order: 11
---

**Deploy** appears under Console → APP only when the project has a backend.

Open it and click **Deploy backend (Development)**. On success the page shows the deployed subdomain (for example **Backend deployed: …**). Projects without a backend do not show this item.

Preview and backend deploy are different: the web UI can appear in **Preview** first; use Deploy when the backend needs to serve APIs.
